questions.q_en: Volume of a cuboid is 111 cm3 more than the volume of a cube of side 9 cm. The ratio of dimensions of the cuboid is 7:5:3, then find the total surface area of cuboid.
questions.solution_en:
Volume of cube of side 9 cm = 9*9*9 = 729 cm3

Volume of a cuboid = 729 + 111 = 840 cm3

Let the dimensions of the cuboid is 7a, 5a and 3a.

7a*5a*3a = 840

a3 = 8

a = 2

Dimensions of the cuboid is 14 cm, 10 cm and 6 cm.

Total surface area of cuboid = 2(14*10 + 10*6 + 6*14) = 568 cm2

questions.q_en: P and Q are two alloys of aluminum and copper. The ratios of aluminum and copper in P and Q are 5 : 11 and 3 : 5, respectively. If a third alloy is formed by mixing alloys P and Q in the ratio of 1 : 3, then aluminum is what percentage (rounded off to the nearest integer) of the copper in the third alloy ?

Part of copper in P = 11/(5 + 11) = 11/16

Part of copper in Q = 5/(3 + 5) = 5/8 = 10/16

Let part of aluminium in third alloy = X

By the rule of alligation:

Part of copper in third alloy = 41

Part of aluminium in third alloy = 64 - 41 = 23

Required percentage = (23/41) * 100

= 56.09%

= 56% (Approximately)

A can do a piece of work in 18 days. B and C together can do the same piece of work in 12 days. If the efficiency of A is 10/9th the efficiency of B, then find the time taken by C to do the same piece of work.
questions.solution_en:
Total work = L.C.M of 18 and 12 = 36

Efficiency = Total work/ Time taken

Efficiency of A = 36/18 = 2

Efficiency of B and C = 36/12 = 3

Efficiency of B = Efficiency of A * 9/10 = 2 * 9/10 = 1.8

Efficiency of C = 3 - 1.8 = 1.2

Hence, the time taken by C to do the same piece of work = 36/1.2 = 30 days

questions.q_en: a7 b8 c7
questions.q_hi: a7 b8 c7
questions.solution_en:
We need to simplify the expression (a7 X b8 X c7)/(a9 X b5 X c4). Using the exponent rule for division, when dividing terms with the same base, subtract the exponents:

For a: a7 / a9 = a(7-9) = a-2

For b: b8 / b5 = b(8 - 5) = b3

For c: c7 / c4 = c(7 - 4) = c3

So, the expression becomes:

a-2 X b3 X c3

Option (c) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: A boat takes 12 hours to swim 15 km downstream and 12 hours to swim 6 km upstream. What is the flow of stream?
questions.solution_en:
Downstream speed (D) = 15/12 = 1.25 km/hr

Upstream speed (U) = 6/12 = 0.5 km/hr

Flow of stream = (1/2) * (D - U)

= (1/2) * (1.25 - 0.5)

= (1/2) * 0.75 = 0.375 km/hr
